==Ingredients==

* 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|plain flour]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 pinch [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard powder]]
*4 oz grated [[Cookbook:Suet|suet]]
*[[Cookbook:Water|Water]]
*1.5 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage meat]]
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*[[Cookbook:Thyme|Thyme]]
* [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|Black pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]

==Procedure==

# Add 1 pinch of salt and 1 pinch of mustard powder to the flour.
# Mix together the suet and flour with enough water to make a [[Cookbook:Dough|doughy]] consistency.
# Cut the pastry into two portions one slightly larger than the other.
# Roll out the larger portion and use it to line a small buttered [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie dish]].
# Finely [[Cookbook:Dice|dice]] the onion.
# Mix together the sausagemeat, diced onion, a pinch of thyme, and plenty of black pepper.
# Mash the mixture into the pie dish making sure there are no voids.
# Wet the edge of the pastry where it covers the lip of the pie dish.
# Roll out the remaining pastry and cover the pie.
# Lightly crimp the edge with your thumb and trim.
# Cut a hole in the top centre of the pie to allow steam to escape.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the oven at 180°C until golden brown on top (30–40 minutes).
# Serve with a little gravy poured over the top.
